catalog.title: Hot Streak I
catalog.rule: 3 wins in a row in a session.

catalog.title: Hot Streak II
catalog.rule: 5 wins in a row in a session.

catalog.title: Hot Streak III
catalog.rule: 8 wins in a row in a session.

catalog.title: Hot Streak IV
catalog.rule: 12 wins in a row in a session.

catalog.title: Cold Spell I
catalog.rule: 5 losses in a row in a session.

catalog.title: Cold Spell II
catalog.rule: 10 losses in a row in a session.

catalog.title: The Comeback
catalog.rule: Lose 3 in a row then win 3 in a row in the same session.

catalog.title: Feast or Famine
catalog.rule: Hit Hot Streak III and Cold Spell I in the same session.

catalog.title: Exact Change
catalog.rule: Bet exactly your balance and win.

catalog.title: Big Nerve
catalog.rule: Bet ≥50% of your balance and win.

catalog.title: Steady Grinder
catalog.rule: Win 10 hands with 1k–5k bets in one session.

catalog.title: Double or Nothing
catalog.rule: Bet your entire balance and win twice in one session.

catalog.title: Escalator
catalog.rule: Place bets of 1k, 5k, 10k, and 50k in a single session.

catalog.title: Roller Coaster
catalog.rule: Within 24h: drop ≥50% from peak then recover to ≥90%.

catalog.title: Lucky Escape I
catalog.rule: Hit from ≤15 to a winning total.

catalog.title: Crowd Pleaser I
catalog.rule: Win in a round with ≥3 players 10 times.

catalog.title: Crowd Pleaser II
catalog.rule: Win in a round with ≥3 players 50 times.

catalog.title: Table Dominator I
catalog.rule: Win a round where all other players lost.

catalog.title: Last One Standing
catalog.rule: Be the only player not to bust in a full table (5 player) round.

catalog.title: Pair
catalog.rule: Make a Pair in your final hand.

catalog.title: Two Pair
catalog.rule: Make Two Pair in your final hand.

catalog.title: Three of a Kind
catalog.rule: Make Three of a Kind in your final hand.

catalog.title: Straight
catalog.rule: Make a Straight in your final hand.

catalog.title: Flush
catalog.rule: Make a Flush in your final hand.

catalog.title: Full House
catalog.rule: Make a Full House in your final hand.

catalog.title: Four of a Kind
catalog.rule: Make Four of a Kind in your final hand.

catalog.title: Straight Flush
catalog.rule: Make a Straight Flush in your final hand.

catalog.title: Full House x5
catalog.rule: Make a Full House 5 times lifetime.

catalog.title: Full House x25
catalog.rule: Make a Full House 25 times lifetime.

catalog.title: Quads x3
catalog.rule: Make Four of a Kind 3 times lifetime.

catalog.title: Quads x10
catalog.rule: Make Four of a Kind 10 times lifetime.

catalog.title: Straight Flush x3
catalog.rule: Make a Straight Flush 3 times lifetime.

catalog.title: Straight Flush x10
catalog.rule: Make a Straight Flush 10 times lifetime.

catalog.title: Poker Bonus 50
catalog.rule: Get ≥50% poker modifier in one hand.

catalog.title: Poker Bonus 100
catalog.rule: Get ≥100% poker modifier in one hand.

catalog.title: Poker Salvation I
catalog.rule: Win a hand you would have lost without the relief modifier.

catalog.title: Clean Poker Win I
catalog.rule: Win a hand AND hit a poker bonus in the same hand.

catalog.title: Royal Treatment
catalog.rule: Hit Quads or Straight Flush twice in one session.
